maryland.songTitle: The Lonesome Death of Hattie Carroll
maryland.linePrev: With rich wealthy parents who provide and protect him
maryland.line: And high office relations in the politics of Maryland
maryland.lineNext: Reacted to his deed with a shrug of his shoulders
stanza: William Zanzinger, who at twenty-four years
Owns a tobacco farm of six hundred acres
With rich wealthy parents who provide and protect him
And high office relations in the politics of Maryland
Reacted to his deed with a shrug of his shoulders
And swear words and sneering, and his tongue, it was a-snarling
And in a matter of minutes, on bail was out walking
